Method of Attack: Exposing an RPC server on open ports allowing remote commands
DNS rebinding to legitimize requests to the RPC server
Obtaining RPC server's authentication secret to gain complete control
Changing default downloads folder to execute malware on boot
Retrieving list of past downloads and previously downloaded files
Discoverer: Google Project Zero security researcher Tavis Ormandy
Attack Vector: Luring victims to malicious websites that interact with the open RPC server
